name: get_directions
description: Get directions between two locations using the Google Routes API. Returns distance, duration, and turn-by-turn steps. Note: arrival_time only works with TRANSIT travel mode.

travel_mode.description: Travel mode: DRIVE, WALK, BICYCLE, or TRANSIT. Defaults to DRIVE. Optional.

departure_time.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for when to depart. Optional.

arrival_time.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for desired arrival time. Only valid for TRANSIT travel mode. Optional.
